svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two side plates 180 x 164 x 6 mm. Four 15.5 mm axle holes in each,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm each side of the middle, 141.5 and 25.5 mm up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge. Drill the two plates clamped together.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Swivel plate 180 x 58 x 12 mm, welded under both side plates so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: their inner faces are 46 mm apart (beam 40 mm, 3 mm each side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot hole 31 mm in the middle of the swivel plate; two 10.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: index holes 45 mm from it, at 0 and 90 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wheels: 6202-2RS bearings on 15 mm axles with spacers; two ride on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top of the beam and two run 1 mm under it (anti-lift).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slide on from the beam end before the end bolts go in, or

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drop on from above and fit the lower axles after.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rolls the full length by hand, no tight spots.
